## What and why

## How it was tested

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] A test fails without this change (or: why no test is possible)
- [ ] No test calls a real provider; no API key, `.env` or report with a key is committed
- [ ] Tried by hand with `--dry-run` (paste the command)

## Presets and docs

- [ ] New or changed presets use archetypes, not real people, and do not read as financial, legal or medical advice
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]` (if users would notice the change)
